name: calmlens-ui-components
description: Upload, comment, avatar and sensitive-media components for React, Vue, Svelte and plain JavaScript. The CalmLens docs show these files.

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.html.json && vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.vue.json && svelte-check --tsconfig tsconfig.svelte.json --fail-on-warnings && biome check .
